question:
The arithmetic mean of the following frequency distribution of number of accidents **X** on week working days is:

 
 

 X:
 2
 4
 <td style="text
solution:
The correct answer is **6.625**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arithmetic mean **is a commonly used measure of central tendency that gives an average of a set of numbers.
 
• The **formula** for finding the arithmetic mean is: (sum of data points x frequency) / total frequency.
 
• The arithmetic mean can be sensitive to extreme values in the data set.
 
• There are other measures of central tendency, such as the median and mode, that can provide a better representation of the data in some cases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• To find the** arithmetic mean** (also known as the **average**), we first need to find the sum of the products of each data point and its frequency, and then divide by the total frequency.
 
• This can be done as follows:
 
 
• (2 x 3) + (4 x 4) + (6 x 2) + (8 x 1) + (10 x 4) + (12 x 2) = 6 + 16 + 12 + 8 + 40 + 24 = 106
 
 
 
• Total frequency = 3 + 4 + 2 + 1 + 4 + 2 = 16
 
• Arithmetic mean = 106 / 16 = 6.625
 
• Understanding the concept of **central tendency** and the **various measures** used to describe it is important for data analysis and interpretation.
 
• It is important to choose the appropriate measure of central tendency depending on the type and distribution of the data being analyzed.
